annotation.title_clean: L'Europe, pionnière en matière de législation sur l'intelligence artificielle : la loi sur l'IA entre en vigueur aujourd'hui
annotation.title_en: Europe, pioneer in artificial intelligence legislation: the AI Act enters into force today
annotation.venue: European Commission Representation in Belgium website
annotation.summary_en: European Commission Representation in Belgium news item of 1 August 2024 announcing the entry into force of the EU AI Act. It explains the four risk tiers, general-purpose AI rules, the AI Office, the phased application timeline, the AI Pact and forthcoming guidelines and codes of practice.
key_provisions_or_claims: AI Act enters into force 1 August 2024 with risk-based classification: minimal, transparency, high, unacceptable risk
Prohibitions on unacceptable-risk systems apply after six months; GPAI rules after 12 months; most rules from 2 August 2026
Member States must designate national enforcement authorities by 2 August 2025
AI Office supported by AI Board, scientific panel and advisory forum
AI Pact encourages voluntary early compliance; codes of practice and guidelines being prepared
